provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: Two noninterconverting components during gradient encoding give normalized attenuation S(b)=sum_i f_i*exp(-b*D_i), with sum f=1 and b>=0. Fast-exchange limit, for the deliberately separate model, uses D_fast=sum f_i*D_i. Fractions are stipulated signal fractions, not inferred mass fractions.
apparent_definition: At each nonzero b report D_app(b)=-ln[S(b)]/b. Do not include a nonexistent b=0 log-ratio value in that array. A common D across all b would require exact single-exponential attenuation, not a one-point fit.
scope: Controlled diffusion-observation models with no convection, relaxation weighting, exchange-rate estimate or real molecular size assignment.
